test_title: PYST 2: SSC JE ME- General Intelligence (Held On 09 Oct 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: Six students E, F, G, H, l and J are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. H is an immediate neighbour of both E and G. I is sitting third to the left of G. E is sitting second to the right of F. J is an immediate neighbour of both F and G. Who is immediate neighbour of both G and F?
solution:
According to the given information,

1) E is sitting second to the right of F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e2ac28c1bb043167e5ba1b0ff860804ed8374ef63e0d832efdf75d1a7e7e795b.png] 

2) H is an immediate neighbour of both E and G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ff26fd90f67b94b044af2b78a7d5623504a5a3fb021aacde091c46e8906698c5.png] 

3) I is sitting third to the left of G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e320f2d5c0d3cd2037070681f1e579b4250cebb96e5b253a7a715f3d32d83fe.png] 

4) J is an immediate neighbour of both F and G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/19148573cb360e27240a70458dec593ba0cb1cd4871f690e413feb9beb9ccc07.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"J".**
